social_media.headline: G1–G2 Geomagnetic Storm Conditions Likely
social_media.summary: G1–G2 geomagnetic storm conditions are possible. Higher-latitude regions are most likely to experience operational effects.

confidence.label: Chance of Onset
confidence.detail: G1 or greater conditions may begin between 1800 UTC Friday and 0600 UTC Saturday.

what_we_know: Possible storm onset ranges from 1200 UTC Friday to 1200 UTC Sunday.
If a storm begins, there is a 60% chance the peak reaches G2.
If a storm begins, there is a 10% chance the peak reaches G3 or greater.
Storm conditions may last 12 to 24 hours.

footer.left: Next update by 0400 UTC Thursday, or sooner if conditions change.
footer.center: No Watch or Warning is in effect.
